name: jediway
description: One way of working for coding agents: engineering taste as skills, roles as skills, and a grounded spec workflow that composes them. Any language, any stack.

interface.shortDescription: Grounded specs, disposable role agents, Staff+ taste
interface.longDescription: jediway gives a coding agent one way of working. Taste lives in plain skills (universal, frontend, backend). Roles (Planner, Implementer, Verifier, Auditor) are plain skills too. The way skill grounds a repo, writes a command-checkable spec, composes each child prompt from the same template, and judges the evidence. Build, review, and audit share the pipeline.
defaultPrompt: $way build: add rate limiting to the login endpoint
$way review: judge the open diff against repo conventions
$way audit: Staff+ architecture audit of this repository
